assign.card: Figma tokens: .fig-near-black scheme + phone sheet for .fig-select

findings.text: Ask 1 wants the contrast note from DS 1.2 shown on the demo page beside the schemes. The diff puts it only in `doc/token-sync.md`; `tokens/page.js` adds the Near-black swatch with no note (requirements 1).

Ask 2's sheet is never shown. The new "Dropdown as a bottom sheet (DS 2.6 C)" heading holds one paragraph and no select. On a phone the demo selects start closed, and shots/…/400.png has no open sheet, so the reviewer cannot see it works. The sheet has no widget under its own heading (CLAUDE.md "show it", page 1).

The `page.js` diff changes the "Español / Français" line although the visible text is identical. That is a likely encoding or byte change, and the shot at 1200 doesn't let me confirm the accents survived (words). Check that the bytes are intact.
Indentation in `page.js` is off: the new `p(...)` and the following `h3` carry an extra tab (code).

At 3440 the dark and near-black cards are clipped at the right edge: a toggle icon is cut off at the card edge in shots/…/3440.png. `layout.json` shows no overflow_x at 400, but that is not measured for 3440 in the part I read.

The sheet is not shown by the `.fig-mobile` class and does not work inside `.fig-lay`. Both limits are documented in `doc/controls.md`, which is good, but the demo's phone layouts demo is a `.fig-lay`, so it cannot demo the sheet there.
Shots given: all four widths (400, 1200, 1920, 3440), one page.

answer.reply: fixed: contrast note now in page.js
fixed: live selects under the sheet heading
fixed: accent bytes were already invalid latin1; now UTF-8
